Cookie notice

What this site stores—and what it does not.

Updated November 5, 2026

What Vorellia’s code does

The current site does not set first-party cookies, use localStorage or sessionStorage, use Google Analytics, or run advertising pixels. The site does not operate a contact form.

Hosting and scheduling

Netlify may use cookies or similar technical mechanisms for hosting and security. Calendly is loaded only after you choose to schedule a meeting and may use cookies or similar technologies under its own notices.

Instagram

Instagram is an external link rather than an embedded feed; its cookie and privacy notices apply after you leave Vorellia’s site.

Your choices and future changes

You can manage cookies through your browser settings. There is currently no non-essential advertising or analytics cookie preference to toggle, so no cookie-consent banner is displayed. If Vorellia adds analytics, advertising pixels, embedded media or other non-essential tracking, this notice and any required consent controls will be updated before activation.

Questions, privacy requests, deletion requests and accessibility feedback can be sent to hello@vorellia.com.
